question: Which of the following Articles deals with the amendment procedure of the Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 368**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Article 368** of the Indian Constitution deals with the **amendment procedure** of the Constitution, enabling Parliament to modify, alter, or repeal any provision of the Constitution.
 
• The Constitution of India provides for two types of amendments: **by a special majority of Parliament** and **through a special majority of Parliament with the ratification by half of the state legislatures**.
 
• Amendments under Article 368 are categorized into three types: **simple majority, special majority, and ratification by states**, depending on the nature
